## Change and purpose

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behaviour.

## Evidence and verification

- [ ] Relevant tests and independent calculations passed; commands/results linked.
- [ ] Any numerical change is explained; frozen forecasting rule is preserved.
- [ ] Historical, synthetic and prospective evidence are labelled accurately.
- [ ] Affected report/notebook/figure claims have been updated together.

## Copyright and sharing

- [ ] New external material and citations have been identified and checked.
- [ ] Each exported artifact has a hash-current destination-specific rights entry.
- [ ] Required attributions/notices are retained; unclear material is excluded.
- [ ] No private WRDS, protected crypto, credentials or unrelated files are included.
- [ ] AI assistance and corrections are recorded without claiming automatic originality.

## Human review

Name the real group reviewer when available. Do not merge until a genuine non-author
review and required checks pass. AI review is supplementary, not a human approval.

## Limitations or follow-up

State unresolved permissions, source gaps or assessment constraints.
